workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

Here is a full list of 30-minute slots where both Elena and David are available next week. Can you please check these against Priya's and Marcus's calendars and find one that works?

Mon: 11:00, 11:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30
Wed: 09:30, 13:00, 13:30, 16:00
Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
Fri: 10:30, 14:30, 15:00, 15:30

Let me know which one to confirm.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Great, I found a time that works for everyone: Thursday at 14:30. I've gone ahead and booked it in the system. The task is ready for you to send the confirmation email.

emails.body: This email confirms the 30-minute partners' meeting has been scheduled. The meeting will take place on Thursday, November 19, at 14:30 Eastern Time. Attendees are Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor.
